tagline.en: Electrocatalysis · Atomically Dispersed Sites · Oxygen Reduction Reaction
tagline.zh: 电催化 · 原子级分散位点 · 氧还原反应

bio.en: I am a Ph.D. candidate in Chemical Engineering at Tsinghua University. My research focuses on non-precious metal catalysts for the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR), bridging experimental synthesis and characterization with density-functional theory to uncover structure–activity relationships at atomically dispersed active sites in surface catalytic processes.
bio.zh: 我是清华大学化学工程系博士研究生，研究方向为面向氧还原反应（ORR）的非贵金属催化剂；通过实验合成与表征结合密度泛函理论，揭示表面催化过程中原子级分散活性位点的构效关系。

title.en: Efficient harvesting of electricity, aromatic aldehydes and H₂ from lignin over nanoflower-like cobalt-based bifunctional electrocatalysts
title.zh: 纳米花状钴基双功能电催化剂从木质素中高效收获电能、芳香醛与 H₂

highlight.en: Self-powered electrocatalytic system using nanoflower-like Co-catalysts for integrated lignin valorization. High-current electrodeposition on Ni foam yields a bifunctional catalyst that simultaneously harvests electricity (196.1 mW cm⁻² peak), aromatic aldehydes (2.90–3.34% yield) and H₂ (12.7 mL cm⁻²) from lignin.
highlight.zh: 构建自驱动电催化体系，利用纳米花状 Co 基催化剂实现木质素一体化增值。在泡沫镍上的大电流电沉积得到双功能催化剂，可同时从木质素中收获电能（峰值 196.1 mW cm⁻²）、芳香醛（产率 2.90–3.34%）与 H₂（12.7 mL cm⁻²）。

title.en: Internally hollow Cu₂O nanoframes with the abundance of {110} facets enhance direct propylene epoxidation
title.zh: 富含 {110} 晶面的内部中空 Cu₂O 纳米框架增强丙烯直接环氧化

highlight.en: Engineered Cu₂O nanoframes via ligand-protected facet etching achieve 0.18 mmol g_cat⁻¹ h⁻¹ PO formation rate with 83.8% selectivity at 175 °C. DFT and characterization confirm Cu₂O {110} facets promote active oxygen species generation and selective epoxidation.
highlight.zh: 通过配体保护的晶面刻蚀设计 Cu₂O 纳米框架，在 175 °C 下取得 0.18 mmol g_cat⁻¹ h⁻¹ 的 PO 生成速率与 83.8% 的选择性。DFT 计算与表征证实 Cu₂O {110} 晶面有利于活性氧物种的生成与选择性环氧化。

title.en: Circumventing radical generation on Fe-V atomic pair catalyst for robust oxygen reduction and zinc-air batteries
title.zh: Fe-V 原子对催化剂规避自由基生成实现稳健的氧还原与锌-空气电池

highlight.en: ORR pathway-switching strategy on DFT-guided Fe₁V₁-NC atomic pair catalysts circumvents ROS generation. The N₂–Fe–N₂–V–N₂ configuration enables direct O=O bond cleavage (side-on adsorption), achieving 16 mV decay over 50 k cycles, E₁/₂ = 0.89 V, and 400 h zinc-air battery durability at 10 mA cm⁻².
highlight.zh: 在 DFT 指导下的 Fe₁V₁-NC 原子对催化剂上提出 ORR 路径切换策略，规避活性氧物种（ROS）的生成。N₂–Fe–N₂–V–N₂ 构型实现 O=O 键侧位吸附与直接断裂，5 万次循环后衰减仅 16 mV，E₁/₂ = 0.89 V，在 10 mA cm⁻² 下锌-空气电池稳定运行 400 h。

title.en: Low-coordinate Cu₁–N₂ sites in single-atom catalyst for highly efficient propylene epoxidation with molecular oxygen
title.zh: 单原子催化剂中低配位 Cu₁–N₂ 位点用于分子氧高效丙烯环氧化

highlight.en: A novel Cu₁–N₂ single-atom catalyst for direct propylene epoxidation, with record PO formation rates. Characterization and DFT show exclusive Cu–N coordination enhances electrophilic oxygen species formation, enabling selective C=C bond activation.
highlight.zh: 提出新型 Cu₁–N₂ 单原子催化剂用于丙烯直接环氧化，PO 生成速率刷新纪录。表征与 DFT 表明 Cu–N 单一配位有利于亲电氧物种生成，从而实现 C=C 键的选择性活化。
